import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXK = 30;
    static final int MAXD = 60;
    static final long mod = 1000000007L;
    static int K;
    static int[] digits = new int[MAXD];

    static class Res {
        int[][] many = new int[MAXK][MAXK];
        int[] inside = new int[MAXK];
        boolean[] exist = new boolean[MAXK];

        Res() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXK; i++) {
                inside[i] = 0;
                exist[i] = false;
                for (int j = 0; j < MAXK; j++) {
                    many[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        Res(Res copy, int rotate) {
            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
                exist[(i + rotate) % K] = copy.exist[i];
                inside[(i + rotate) % K] = copy.inside[i];
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    many[(i + rotate) % K][(j + rotate) % K] = copy.many[i][j];
                }
            }
        }

        Res(Res a, Res b) {
            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
                exist[i] = a.exist[i] || b.exist[i];

                inside[i] = a.inside[i];
                if (!a.exist[i]) {
                    inside[i] = (int)((inside[i] + b.inside[i]) % mod);
                }
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    inside[i] = (int)((inside[i] + (long) a.many[i][j] * b.inside[j]) % mod);
                    many[i][j] = 0;
                    if (!b.exist[j]) {
                        many[i][j] = a.many[i][j];
                    }
                    if (!a.exist[i]) {
                        many[i][j] = (int)((many[i][j] + b.many[i][j]) % mod);
                    }
                    for (int m = 0; m < K; m++) {
                        many[i][j] = (int)((many[i][j] + (long) a.many[i][m] * b.many[m][j]) % mod);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextInt();

        int nd = 0;
        long x = n;
        while (x > 0) {
            digits[nd++] = (int)(x % K);
            x /= K;
        }

        Res[] retpk = new Res[MAXD];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXD; i++) {
            retpk[i] = new Res();
        }

        retpk[0].exist[0] = true;
        retpk[0].inside[0] = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            retpk[0].many[0][j] = 1;
        }

        for (int pk = 1; pk < nd; pk++) {
            retpk[pk] = new Res(retpk[pk - 1], 0);
            for (int v = 1; v < K; v++) {
                retpk[pk] = new Res(retpk[pk], new Res(retpk[pk - 1], v));
            }
        }

        Res result = new Res();
        int sum = 0;

        for (int d = nd - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
            for (int v = 0; v < digits[d]; v++) {
                result = new Res(result, new Res(retpk[d], (sum + v) % K));
            }
            sum += digits[d];
        }

        long result_sum = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            result_sum = (result_sum + result.inside[i]) % mod;
        }

        System.out.println(result_sum);
        sc.close();
    }
}
